comparisons.2025: 120kW MGU-K, MGU-H recovers energy from turbo exhaust gases
comparisons.2026: 350kW MGU-K — nearly 3x more power. MGU-H completely removed.
comparisons.impact: Far more electric power especially on acceleration zones. Battery management becomes critical race strategy element. Drivers will feel massive torque difference.
comparisons.tweetAngle: This is basically a Formula E car with a V6 attached — 350kW electric is INSANE

comparisons.2025: Fixed wings, teams optimize setup for specific track characteristics. Manual DRS on straights.
comparisons.2026: Active aero — wings adjust angle automatically every corner and straight. No manual DRS.
comparisons.impact: Less setup dependency between tracks, better overtaking, significantly less dirty air for following cars. Should improve racing quality dramatically.
comparisons.tweetAngle: Cars basically have their own permanent DRS that's smarter than any driver could manage

comparisons.2025: 798kg minimum weight — heaviest cars in F1 history
comparisons.impact: Lighter = faster through corners, better driver feel, more responsive. Back to proper racing car proportions after years of bloated cars.
comparisons.tweetAngle: Finally! F1 cars going on a diet — 30kg lighter means they'll actually feel like racing cars again

comparisons.2025: 10% sustainable fuel content in fuel mix
comparisons.impact: Massive green milestone for the sport. No performance difference felt by drivers — same energy density achieved.
comparisons.tweetAngle: F1 goes fully green fuel without sacrificing a single horsepower — engineering marvel

comparisons.2026: 50% combustion, 50% electric — equal split for first time ever
comparisons.impact: Unprecedented in F1. Creates entirely new strategic dimension around battery deployment and energy harvesting.
comparisons.tweetAngle: Half electric, half combustion — F1 2026 is genuinely unlike anything we've seen

comparisons.2025: MGU-H harvests energy from turbo — complex, expensive, unreliable for new manufacturers
comparisons.2026: MGU-H completely abolished — simplified hybrid system
comparisons.impact: Easier for new manufacturers (Audi, Cadillac) to enter. Reduces development cost and complexity. Reliability should improve.
comparisons.tweetAngle: Removing MGU-H was the right call — it was a $50M barrier keeping new teams out of F1

comparisons.2025: 2000mm wide — very wide cars limiting wheel to wheel racing
comparisons.2026: Narrower specification — exact mm TBC but significant reduction
comparisons.impact: Narrower cars = more room to race side by side. Better overtaking opportunities especially on tighter circuits.
comparisons.tweetAngle: Narrower cars mean actual wheel to wheel racing instead of processional single file
